scope: Shared subscription lifecycle under complete synthetic Node suites; no native stream or installed/rendered UI execution

subscription.cursor: Acknowledged only after the selected consumer accepts a committed event
subscription.rotation: Native reconnect end opens the same scoped feed at the delivered cursor
subscription.retirement: Abort and clear only observation; reject delayed old-epoch events/outcomes/retries
subscription.failurePolicy: At most three retries for marked fetch/body transport unavailability or HTTP 503; authentication, protocol and consumer rejection stop explicitly
subscription.consumerTypeError: Tagged as delivery failure; cannot trigger a transport retry

tests: Matching watch is idempotent and connection rotation resumes acknowledged cursor
Replacement aborts stale feed and rejects its event/terminal outcome
Retirement, origin changes and disposal suppress delayed retry
Busy retry bound and auth/interrupted/malformed acknowledgements stop
Consumer TypeError does not acknowledge or retry
Invalid binding cannot open or schedule a feed
